'''Anakin's shuttle''' was an [[Eta-class shuttle|''Eta''-class shuttle]] that used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] used it during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]].
